content.comment_body: Hello, I'm planning to create a test setup using a [product_name] logic module, and will purchase the [product_name] Starter Box. See [url]. I've already written the program using the [product_name] software, but I have a question. For this rig, we'd like to record current measurements using a transducer connected to an analog input. Afterwards, we want this data available on a computer, for example in Excel. Is it possible to transfer data from the PLC to the computer using that modem? See [url]. Additionally, is it possible for the modem to send an email via the computer in case of a fault? Thank you
The doesn't include a mail function. You can use a GSM modem to send values and warnings to your phone. See [url]. Hope this helps.
I've seen the GSM modem option, but it's too expensive for my needs. Thanks for clarifying that emailing isn't supported. Regarding data capture—can data be extracted from the PLC to a computer?
Take a look at the German forum: [url] It discusses logging data, such as into Excel. Best regards, [user_name]
Thank you. I will check the German website, though it's a challenge to translate!
You can solve that using Google Translate.

I use [product_name] Monitor ([url]) with a Sharkoon USB LanPort 100 ([url]) to achieve this. The Sharkoon USB LanPort connects the [product_name] to LAN, allowing access over the network. With a 10-second update interval, it works well. The monitor software can update every 500 milliseconds, but the Sharkoon device can't handle that speed. The [product_name] Monitor offers email functionality and is quick to set up (about 2 minutes, from download to logging). See [url] for a video demonstration.
Thanks! I expect to receive my [product_name] next week, so I’ll try it out and provide feedback on whether it works.
A new question by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread about sending online commands from PC to [product_name] version_no. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are seeking methods to export analog input data from a [product_name] logic module to a computer, particularly for use in Excel. There's uncertainty about whether the module supports email notifications via modem, and how easily data can be captured for use in third-party software. Users tend to prefer simple, affordable solutions for remote monitoring and data logging. The lack of built-in email or economical communication features in the [product_name] is frequently mentioned as a limitation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to quickly and easily export analog data from the [product_name] module to their computers, and receive notifications such as email alerts when certain conditions are met. They expect the solution to be cost-effective and straightforward to set up.
